column-wise operations
description:
Hi @gvwilson, 

This PR adds a concept map for column-wise operations in `dplyr`, in both `.svg` and `.png` formats as per the contributing guidelines. I could definitely add more detail but was striving for parsimony, so please let me know if you'd like me to tweak anything. I think it nicely complements the concept map on `dplyr::across()`, so I added it in the README right next to that one. Thanks so much for organizing these. I used a dozen or so of these in my teaching last week and they were incredibly useful! 

Cheers,
Brendan

title: Replace drawio with svg in What about translations?
Add concept map for pipe operator
description:
This PR adds a concept map for the pipe operator (`%>%`). I hope that you find this a useful addition. 

Included are the SVG and PNG as described in the README. README.md has been updated accordingly. I suspect that README.html is generated from README.md. If I know how, I'd be happy to add it to this PR.

Thank you for considering merging this PR.

Best wishes,

Jeroen
